name: Charlie Bravo SOS
summary:
SOS! A distress call has arrived. Send your loyal search-and-rescue dog Charlie into the unknown from the comfort of your living room. In Mixed Reality, a game of fetch unfolds on a cosmic scale beyond your walls.

Track his journey on a holo-map, rescue stranded characters, explore bizarre twisted worlds, and remote-control powerful machines to aid his mission. Inspect the strange treasures Charlie brings all the way home to you, and reward him with a well-earned chin scratch.
